description: Render the current drawing as an inline PNG (also written to disk: outDir, else $CLASSCAD_SNAPSHOT_DIR, else <tmpdir>/classcad-snapshots). The image is returned to the MODEL as an inline image block — no follow-up Read is needed to see it. The USER usually does not see tool results. At the end of a build (not after every tweak), SHOW them the render: with a file-sending tool (Claude Code: SendUserFile), send the saved PNG; otherwise embed it in your reply as a Markdown image with its absolute path, ![render](/abs/path.png) — Codex and most chat hosts display that. Hosts preview only files inside the session's own folders (Claude Code: the scratchpad directory or the project) — anywhere else the user gets a grey placeholder card. So when you intend to send the render, pass outDir = your scratchpad directory (or a folder in the project). Call after a meaningful geometry change, NOT after every parameter tweak. Verification options: section (cut through internals), sheet (four labeled views, shared ortho scale), drawing (technical drawing: front/top/side with hidden lines dashed, placed first- or third-angle — compare against a reference drawing), lines (line style: visible edges solid, hidden dashed), highlight (face/edge/body ids in signal color), markers (probe crosshairs at world points), sketchOverlay (sketch curves on their real plane), annotate (extents + axes triad + scale bar), xray (hidden geometry shines through), colors "distinct" (one color per body — booleans/splits/patterns), frame (pin an earlier snapshot's reported frame for pixel-comparable before/after).

annotate.description: Measurement overlay: bbox extents, view-oriented axes triad, scale bar.

colors.description: "native" (default): the model's own colors. "distinct": one palette color per body.

drawing.description: Technical drawing in ONE image: front, top and side view in line style (hidden edges dashed), aligned at one scale, plus a shaded iso. "first-angle" (ISO E, Europe; true): top view BELOW front, view from the left RIGHT of it. "third-angle" (ISO A, US): top view ABOVE front, view from the right RIGHT of it. Use the method of the reference drawing, then compare view by view. Takes precedence over sheet.

frame.description: Pin the frame reported by an earlier snapshot (same view/size) for pixel-comparable before/after.

highlight.description: Ids rendered in signal color: graphic container ids, owning solid ids, face mesh ids, edge ids. CAUTION: face/edge ids are only stable within one graphic payload (recalc reassigns them) — across tool calls use highlightAt.

highlightAt.description: World points [[x,y,z],…]: the closest FACE in the rendered payload is highlighted per point. Geometrically anchored — the robust way to highlight a face found via run_script (return a point on it, not its mesh id).

lines.description: Line style instead of shading: visible edges and silhouettes solid, hidden edges dashed. Hidden lines show bores, pockets, hollow vs solid. Works for the single view and every sheet panel.

lookAt.description: World-space [x,y,z] that lands at screen center. Omit for bbox center.

markers.description: Probe markers (crosshair + label) at world coordinates, drawn on top.

outDir.description: Absolute directory for the PNG (created if missing). Pass your session scratchpad when the user should see the file — hosts preview only files in session folders.

recalc.description: Default false. Opt in only to regenerate; keep false for solid.*/entity-injection sessions — a recalc invalidates curve shape ids and can destroy injected bodies.

section.description: Cut the solids at a plane; the positive side of the normal is removed. The cut faces are filled and hatched like a drawing's section (wall thicknesses, bores and pockets read directly); cap: false leaves the cut open with interior walls shaded. Combine with drawing for a section view.

anyOf.description: Turntable camera in DEGREES (Z-up): azimuth 0 = front, 90 = camera at +X; elevation 0 = horizon, 90 = top.
Explicit orthographic look direction (from camera toward the scene).
Turntable camera in DEGREES (Z-up): azimuth 0 = front, 90 = camera at +X; elevation 0 = horizon, 90 = top.
Explicit orthographic look direction (from camera toward the scene).

sheet.description: Multi-view sheet in ONE image. true or 4 views = quadrants (default top/iso/front/right; ortho views share one scale). 2 views = side-by-side panels labeled A | B — use for the mirror check: [matched view, same view with negated azimuth] in a single render.

sketchOverlay.description: Draw sketch curves in 3D on their actual plane over the solid render.

source.description: "stl": render the tessellated STL export instead of the engine graphic (explicit fallback; no brep edges).

supersample.description: Anti-aliasing: render at k× and downscale to width×height (default 2; 1 = raw aliased pixels). Output size and image tokens are unchanged.

anyOf.description: Turntable camera in DEGREES (Z-up): azimuth 0 = front, 90 = camera at +X; elevation 0 = horizon, 90 = top.
Explicit orthographic look direction (from camera toward the scene).

view.description: Camera: named view (default "iso") or arbitrary orthographic camera.

xray.description: Translucent bodies — hidden geometry shines through.

zoom.description: Multiplier on auto-fit scale. 1=fit-all (default), >1 zooms in.
